dsDescriptionValue.value: This dataset contains information about the number and origin of the Amsterdam immigrants in the period 1578-1810. The data are subdivided in total, male and female, per region or place of origin. The dataset is based on lists compiled by the Amsterdam archivist dr. Simon Hart and his colleagues between 1960 and 1979.
